about.bio1: Holistic therapy is a health and wellness care approach that sees the person as a whole, not just as a symptom or a disease. It considers in an integrated way the physical, mental, emotional, spiritual, and social aspects.
about.bio2: The central idea is that everything is connected: if something is not in balance in one of these areas, it can affect the others.
